label: A common first esse giver from one actual bearer and well-founded causes (inference)
rule: Use well-foundedness to exclude an identity return and apply the existing one-bearer source theorem
meaning: Keep the ancestry principle, at-most-one identity bearer, well-foundedness and excluded middle of 5ab6cc2b. One actual bearer suffices: if it has represented esse–essence identity, use it directly, and if distinct, use its supplied identity ancestor. The inherited one-bearer argument identifies the selected identity bearer as the common source and excludes actual incoming supply by ruling out a nonempty return path. All premises are recorded explicitly. The conclusion supplies only the common source in the fixed esse profile.
